clips.title: The story
paras: The Main Hall is the central entrance chamber of Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest. It serves as the primary crossroads connecting the abbey's grounds to its upper tower, the Hall of Arms, and the Library Wing. Here, newly recruited human adventurers report to receive their initial assignments in service of the Kingdom of Stormwind.

Stepping through the grand archways of Northshire Abbey brings visitors directly into the Main Hall. As the building's central hub, it channels arriving trainees and clerical staff between the abbey's distinct wings: the martial Hall of Arms on one side, the scholastic Library Wing on the other, and the stairs rising into the abbey tower. The quiet sanctuary of the hall is tempered by the ongoing strife in the valley, as officers rally able-bodied newcomers to defend the kingdom's borders.
